description: A `return` in a top-level arm of EVERY form has no function to leave: an alternation arm bare (`.A | .B :> return`) and braced, a §18.19 product arm, and `!{}` handler arms (statement and decl) — each is E-STMT-RETURN-OUTSIDE-FUNCTION (S462 review N1).
rationale: §18.2 "Leaving arms": legality by context — `return` needs an enclosing function. Raw-text arm forms (alternation, product, handler) were never walked, so they compiled clean and the `return` left the client init function or was swallowed; the arm body is now read by the one arm-body reader (arm-body-statements.ts).
